hints.title: Earliest Inversion Pivot
hints.text: Identify the earliest index i where a strictly smaller character exists further down the string.

hints.title: Minimal Suffix Target
hints.text: Locate the occurrences of the minimal suffix character min(s[i:]) and reverse up to those endpoints.

hints.title: Optimal Tie-Breaking
hints.text: Compare candidate strings resulting from reversals to each identical minimum character position.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass identifying earliest actionable inversion pivot.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all N^2 substring reversals naively requires O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory for candidate string comparisons.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify that the optimal reversal start point is strictly fixed by the first non-minimal character.
